blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office donated medicines and vitamins to three barangays, namely Barangay Tibag, Barangay Magsaysay in Talugtug, Nueva Ecija, and Barangay 420, Zone 43, District IV, Manila. PCSO Medical Services Department – Satellite Division Chief Dr. Rouel Aparato led the ceremonial turnover held on November 19, 2026, at the PCSO Conservatory. Representatives of the beneficiary barangays, led by Barangay Captains Dionisio Ortiz and Floro Pagaduan Sr., and Barangay Secretary Rudylinda Domingo of District IV, Manila, expressed their gratitude and recognized the significant contribution of the donations in addressing the healthcare needs of their respective constituents.
